final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count, AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT s.sex, s.record_count, CAST(s.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count, s.record_count - t.average_count FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND t.average_count IS NOT NULL AND s.record_count > t.average_count
